text:
Maya (People Ops): quick check-in — Luis (incoming H-1B transfer) has a US consulate appointment in Mexico City for stamping next week. Hes asked whether we can (a) hold his start date if stamping slips, (b) cover dependent (spouse) visa fees, and (c) confirm benefits eligibility if he starts remote from Mexico for a short period. Need triage.
Ethan R (Recruiter): Offer accepted; target start date June 7. Spouse Maria plans to apply as H-4 dependent. Luis asked for a single employer letter he can bring for both applicants.
Claire (Immigration Counsel): For H-1B transfer + consular stamping, employer letter should state role, salary, start date intent, and that employment will commence upon lawful admission. We can say we will hold the role for administrative delays up to 30 days, but avoid longer guarantees. For dependents, include that Redwood supports H-4 application but dependent fees are generally employee's responsibility unless policy exception.
Nadia (Hiring Manager): Role blurb: "Luis will be Senior Systems Engineer on Serving Runtime. Hell lead KV-cache scaling, batching heuristics, and mentor the infra team on kernel integration (project SR-EMEA)." Good to include urgency: EMEA customer pilot in July needs his expertise.
Sam (Payroll): Payroll notes: cannot put someone on US payroll before admission; if Luis is starting remote outside US we can set a contingency remote-start for up to 14 days with no payroll until he enters US. Benefits require active payroll enrollment; we can prepare enrollment paperwork to activate after admission. If Luis will be physically abroad >14 days and paid, we need Global Mobility review.
Luis (candidate): Appreciate the clarity. Two asks from my side: 1) can Redwood pre-pay H-4 visa fees and IHS for my spouse and then deduct from my first payroll (if allowed)? 2) can the company pre-approve DHL courier for passport return? My last stamping needed express service.
Maya (People Ops): Policy: we occasionally offer a dependent-fee advance for senior hires; need manager approval. Courier pre-approval up to $300 auto; >$300 manager sign-off. Nadia can you approve a dependent-fee advance up to $1,200 for this hire?
Nadia (Hiring Manager): Approve dependent-fee advance up to $1,200 charged to SR-EMEA budget, conditional on reimbursement plan. Also approve courier up to $350 if required.
Ethan R (Recruiter): I'll DM Luis the reimbursement plan and expense flow (advance + deduction option). Luis, please upload the DHL quote if you need >$300.
Luis (candidate): Uploaded DHL Express quote (USD 328) to expense request. Also DM'ed passport name/number to Maya. Thank you.
Claire (Immigration Counsel): I'll draft the employer letter and add the clause about holding position for administrative delays up to 30 days. Also suggest we include a line: "Redwood will provide support for dependent visa application; a one-time fee advance may be provided subject to manager approval." Good?
Maya (People Ops): Yes. Also add contact for consulate follow-up: people-ops@redwood.ai and legal@redwood.ai. After Claire drafts, please route to Legal for sign-off — allow 24 hours.
Sam (Payroll): Action: once Luis is admitted and EAD entry stamp is confirmed, payroll can retroactively process his first pay from start date if documentation provided within payroll window. If delay > pay cycle, first paycheck may align to next cycle. We'll note benefits enrollment cutoffs to candidate.
Ethan R (Recruiter): Luis  — please confirm travel dates and whether you'll ask for leave in Workday or file as visa travel.
Luis (candidate): Travel Apr 29  May 6. I'll file visa travel leave in Workday now.
Maya (People Ops): Great. Claire, target to share draft employer letter by EOD today. Nadia/Sam ack when salary/coverage/courier approvals are final.
Claire (Immigration Counsel): Draft ready, posting snippet: "Date: Apr 28, 2026
To: Consular Section, Mexico City
Re: Support for H-1B stamping  Luis Gomez (passport X1234567)

Redwood Inference confirms an offer of employment to Luis Gomez as Senior Systems Engineer with an annual base salary of USD 170,000. Anticipated start date: June 7, 2026. Luiss role is critical to our July EMEA pilot. Redwood will support dependent visa application for his spouse and may provide a one-time fee advance subject to manager approval. Redwood will hold the position for up to 30 days in the event of administrative stamping delays. For verification contact people-ops@redwood.ai."
Claire (Immigration Counsel): Routing to legal@redwood.ai now for final sign-off.
Nadia (Hiring Manager): Ack  salary and advance approved.
Sam (Payroll): Ack  payroll notes understood. Candidate must upload passport admission stamp when back for payroll activation.
Luis (candidate): Thanks everyone  I got the draft and it's perfect. Appreciate the DHL approval.
people-ops-bot: Thread archived to #people-ops for audit and record-keeping.
